title.zh: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents
title.en: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents

current_state.zh: Nvidia unveiled the OpenShell Reference Architecture at GTC Berlin, combining Vera CPUs, the open-source OpenShell runtime, and BlueField-4 chips running Sentry to isolate, inspect, and quarantine AI agents at the hardware level, with CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, and Check Point integrating support ahead of planned availability early next year.
